dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.text: I want to eat better, but I do not know where to start.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A balanced diet is the best way to start. Do you eat many vegetables?

dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.text: Not really. I mostly eat pasta and fast food.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Try to have at least two portions of vegetables with every meal.

dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.text: That sounds hard. What about sugar? I love cakes and soft drinks.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: You should avoid too much sugar, but you do not have to stop completely.

dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.text: What can I drink instead of soft drinks?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Water, tea, or water with a slice of lemon.

dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.text: And what do you eat for breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Usually yogurt with fruit, or eggs with bread.

dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.text: That is simple. Maybe I can cook more at home.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes! Cooking at home is cheaper and healthier.
